ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by an approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/ochre) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity (black) contiguous region extending from the base to the median notch. Lateral high-intensity (white) lobes containing diffuse ochre-colored clusters (staining) concentrated along the upper margins and lobe centers. Scattered discrete low-intensity point clusters (rosettes) distributed bilaterally across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees; vertex depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel fluctuations (serrations). Notable high-intensity pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) create extreme textural irregularities at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe boundaries exhibit a sigmoidal curve; convexity originates from the median notch, transitioning to slight terminal concavity at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular and annular low-intensity pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, with higher density on the interior regions of the high-intensity fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible low-intensity linear vectors. Left lobe: single diagonal mark. Right lobe: complex intersecting multi-linear feature (rake mark) in the lower central quadrant consisting of at least four distinct diverging vectors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast, high-texture barnacle encrustations on the distal tips and sporadically along the trailing edge. Widespread non-white pigment staining (ochre/brown) covering approximately 40% of the high-intensity lobe surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique geometric linear intersection on the lower-right lobe forming a distinctive branching or 'K'-shaped pattern.
